title: UAAP: Balliner hat-trick powers UST over UE
summary: Joshua Balliner netted a hat-trick in University of Santo Tomas' 5-1 demolition of University of the East in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament, Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
